newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kaufring 96 net profit of 3.4 mln DM.
newsitem.headline: Kaufring 96 net profit of 3.4 mln DM.

text.p: German retail group Kaufring AG said on Monday group net profit in 1996 rose to 3.4 million marks after a loss of 3.2 million the year before.
Group sales for 1996 were 2.928 billion marks, down from 3.068 billion marks in 1995. It also said it wanted to build on profit results in 1997, although group sales were likely to fall again.
Chief executive Peter Kausemann blamed the drop in sales in 1996 on weak consumer demand.
Although the unfavourable demand was continuing this year, the company expected better cost management to allow for an improvement in results in 1997, Kausemann said.
A restructuring has reduced costs by 20 million to 30 million marks this year, the company said previously.
Kaufring said in March it expected final 1996 results to show a net profit and that this could allow for a dividend payment. -- Bonn newsroom, +49-228 26097150
